title: Guideline domain
description: Which of three domains a WHO guideline's recommendations address: clinical care, public health, or health-system strengthening (bean folio-assistant-398x). Owner, 2026-10-10: "these will all need to be a part of a SMART Guideline at some point and are one of clinical health, public health, or health system strengthening guidlines ... In any case these all will be be in the Glossary and can be sorted out later." Applied to a guideline through an intake classification that names its source, and to each recommendation-scenario candidate. To be promoted to a CodeSystem in the clinical-guidance content layer once the process catalogues exist. Each term is linked by closeMatch to its closest MeSH descriptors, looked up and verified against https://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/ on 2026-10-23.

terms.definition: A guideline whose recommendations address the care of individual patients by health workers: assessment, diagnosis, treatment and management of a condition in a person.
terms.scopeNote: Looked up against the MeSH RDF API (https://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/, 2026-10-23): closeMatch to MeSH D017065 ('Practice Guideline', Publication Type; entry terms 'Clinical Guideline', 'Clinical Practice Guideline') and D015510 ('Clinical Medicine', Topical Descriptor). Neither is an exactMatch because this concept classifies a guideline's domain within a three-way partition (clinical, public health, health system strengthening) rather than publication form or the medical discipline as a whole.

terms.definition: A guideline whose recommendations address the health of populations rather than of an individual patient: prevention, health promotion, immunization and screening programmes, surveillance, and policy or environmental measures.
terms.scopeNote: Looked up against the MeSH RDF API (https://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/, 2026-10-23): closeMatch to MeSH D011634 ('Public Health', Topical Descriptor) and D015980 ('Public Health Practice', Topical Descriptor). Recorded as closeMatch rather than exactMatch because this concept classifies a guideline's domain rather than the field of public health itself.

terms.definition: A guideline whose recommendations address how the health system itself is organised and resourced — service delivery, health workforce, health information systems, access to medical products, financing, and leadership and governance — rather than a particular condition or population intervention.
terms.scopeNote: The six areas follow WHO's health-system building blocks (Everybody's business, 2007). Looked up against the MeSH RDF API (https://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/, 2026-10-23): MeSH holds no single descriptor for 'health system strengthening' (none found for the compound term); recorded as closeMatch to MeSH D003695 ('Delivery of Health Care', entry terms 'Health Care Systems', 'Healthcare Systems') and D057191 ('Capacity Building').
